scripts.psql: docker compose exec db psql -U ruina ruina
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --project unit && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:conformance: node tools/cargo.mjs build --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml && vitest run --project conformance
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:integration && npm run test:stress
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run deadcode && npm run lint:rust && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:beta: npm run check && npm run test:conformance && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:release: npm run check:beta && npm run test:stress
scripts.balance: node tools/cargo.mjs run --release --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --bin balance < tools/balance/scenario.json
scripts.lint:rust: node tools/cargo.mjs fmt --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --check && node tools/cargo.mjs clippy --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
